stop_reason: No exercise contrast: GSE242294 contains only untreated (no exercise) WT vs miR-92b knockout gastrocnemius (GEO treatment '8 weeks-old mice without treatment'; paper S3.5.p1/FIG6). Every sample is sedentary, so the effect of exercise on gene expression is not identifiable from these data. The only analyzable contrast (KO vs WT) is a genotype effect and is not the requested estimand; the paper's exercise evidence (FIG1 trained vs untrained) is qPCR of miR-92b only and was not sequenced.
